name: montycap
description: Monte Carlo simulation tool for capacity planning

scripts.validate: npx eslint src/simulation.js src/ui.js && npm run build && npx html-validate web/index.html && npm test
scripts.threatmodel: threatcl validate threatmodel/*.hcl && threatcl dashboard -outdir=docs/threatmodel -overwrite threatmodel/*.hcl && threatcl dfd -outdir=docs/threatmodel -format=svg -overwrite threatmodel/*.hcl
